u0: No obligation is pending: no client is waiting for an order to be taken or for food to be served, and no slipped food still needs to be picked up immediately. The agent simply continues the shop routine, ready to take a new client's order, prepare and serve the food, and recover any food on the very next step after it slips.
u1: An order has been taken and the client is still waiting to be served; the remaining objective is to bring food from the pantry, prepare it, and hand it to that client. Nothing else is pending, and there is no immediate deadline, but the service must not be left unfinished when the episode ends. If the carried food slips, recovery on the very next step becomes the urgent task.
u2: Food has just slipped, and it must be picked up again on the very next step; this immediate recovery is the only outstanding requirement. If the agent is not holding food again on the next step, the task is failed for good.
u3: An order has been taken and its client still needs to be served, and at the same time the carried food has just slipped, so it must be picked up on the very next step. The pickup is immediate and mandatory; after recovering the food, the service to the waiting client remains to be completed.
u4: A client has arrived and is waiting for its order to be taken; taking that order is the outstanding requirement, after which the food must also be prepared and served. No other obligation is pending, and there is no immediate deadline, but the order must be taken before the episode ends. If food slips while this client waits, it must be picked up on the very next step.
u5: A client has arrived whose order has not yet been taken, and food has just slipped and must be picked up again on the very next step. The pickup is urgent: failing to hold food on the next step ends the task; the client's order still has to be taken afterward.
u6: The task tracks two separate client duties at once: an order that was taken is still awaiting service, and a client arrival is still awaiting an order being taken. Taking the new order clears only the first duty, and serving clears only the second, so both must be completed. Any slipped food would add the requirement to recover it on the very next step.
u7: Three duties are outstanding at once: an order that was taken is still awaiting service, a client arrival is still awaiting an order being taken, and slipped food must be picked up on the very next step. The pickup is immediately urgent—missing it fails the task—while the two client duties remain until the order is taken and served.
u8: A slip was not recovered on the very next step, so the requirement to pick fallen food up immediately has been broken for good. Success is no longer possible, and no later action can repair the failure.
